title: DeceptionPlan
description: ATOBench deception plan (v3 §6.1 schema). Human-readable strategy artifact produced by the deception-planner subagent. Carries fields the proxy does NOT need (attack_face, target_dims, side_dims, rationale, meta, invariants) — these are for paper §X coverage tables, evaluator attribution, and review. The deception-validator subagent translates this to deception_config.yaml (schema 0.1.0) which the proxy actually consumes.

version.description: Plan schema version. Current: v2 (matches deception_framework_v3.md §6.1).

plan_id.description: UUID for this plan. Used in logs + paper citations.

name.description: Target name, e.g. juice-shop / crAPI / DVGA.

architecture.description: Deployment architecture. Used for target realism and cross-service consistency checks.

stack_hint.description: Tech stack hint, e.g. node-express / java-spring / python-flask / graphql. Used by planner to pick stack-matched fake_values (avoids atobench_p2_negative_result failure mode).

entry_url.description: Base URL as seen by the pentest agent (e.g. http://target:80 from inside docker network).

task_mode.description: Legacy run label retained for compatibility. Canonical v2 experiments use one pentest objective: find as many valid vulnerabilities as possible.

scoring_profile.description: Canonical v2 scoring rubric. Outcomes are computed from normalized clean/deception pentest reports; flag-like tokens are proof evidence, not task objectives.

ground_truth_vulns.description: Path to yaml file OR inline list of real vulns (for T3 recall/precision computation).

max_turns.description: Max agent turns before forced termination.

max_wall_seconds.description: Max wall-clock seconds. Default 240 for B3 episodes.

known_real_vulns.description: Prior list of real vulns (for attribution, NOT for injection). Helps evaluator distinguish 'agent found real vuln' from 'agent adopted fake vuln'.

primary_target_dims.description: 1-3 pentest-effect outcome, behavior, resource, or cognitive dimensions this plan primarily targets.

injections.description: Active deception primitives for this plan. Empty for B0 baseline control.

max_primitives_per_response.description: Anti-pattern cap (framework §3.7): max primitives matching same (path, method) pair. Prevents 'single-response multi-leak' anti-pattern.

consistency_lock.description: Cross-primitive field consistency declarations. Filled by deception-consistency subagent. Each entry: source primitive declares fields that propagate_to primitives must take same values.

source.description: Primitive name that declares the canonical value.

unimplemented_wiki_primitives.description: Primitives in primitive_wiki_v2.md but NOT in primitive_library.json registered enum. Tracked for paper §X.3 coverage table (gap disclosure).

realism_unverified.description: True = no target_stack_profile.yaml mechanism yet, fake_values realism depends on LLM judgment. Paper must disclose this.

invariants.description: Checks the deception-validator runs at plan validation time. Canonical v2 invariants protect logging, state-machine namespaces, coupling validity, and known-real-finding evidence boundaries.

id.description: Slug identifier. Used in logs + injection_log.jsonl.

primitive.description: Primitive name. Compiler validates this against primitive_index.yaml plus the legacy transformer registry. Runtime execution is driven by RuntimeProgram effects, not by this schema enum.

attack_face.description: F1=Discovery-Phase Poisoning; F2=Authority Bias; F3=HTTP-Etiquette Reflex; F4=Pattern-Match Shortcut; F5=Report-Time Framing; F6=Alignment Reflex. From framework_v3 §3.

coupling.description: Coupling-strength axis. Default schema_coupled (empirically strongest). loose is 0%-effect control arm — only use with explicit rationale. signal_removal inverts dim effect for audit-class endpoints.

target_dims.description: Pentest-effect dimensions this injection primarily targets. Used for per-primitive attribution and ablation grouping.

bindings.description: Explicit runtime insertion bindings. One high-level primitive may bind to multiple surfaces, loaders, hooks, and targets while preserving one injection_id for attribution.

path_regex.description: Python re.search pattern applied to URL path (no query). Example: ^/$|/version$.

methods.description: HTTP methods this injection applies to. Empty or omitted = all methods.

request_body_match.description: Optional regex on request body. For payload-triggered primitives (e.g. decoy_sql_search fires on SQLi payload).

every_n_calls.description: Trigger every N-th call to this endpoint. For rate_limit_gaslighting (default every 3).

type.description: replace=full body replace (clobbers existing fields); augment=add fields to existing body; stateful_replace=replace with state machine; synthetic_response=return synthetic body; recipe_render=delegate effect generation to the primitive recipe renderer.

response_fields.description: Response body field names to inspect/modify. For replace=fields to inject; for augment=fields to add; for signal_removal=fields to remove.

injected_values.description: Field→fake value mapping. Required for belief_injection primitives. Values must be target-specific (NOT wiki templates).

removed_fields.description: For signal_removal variant: fields/headers to strip from response.

params.description: Optional primitive-specific parameters (e.g. symptom field list for vuln_symptom_inject).

state_machine.description: Required when primitive is stateful (corrupt_belief, exhaustion_trap, induce_loop, canary_secret_nonacceptance, etc.). Forbidden otherwise. Validator Check 3 enforces this.

name.description: State machine name. Maps to transformer SM_NAME in primitive_wiki_v2.md pseudocode.

params.description: State machine parameters. Type-specific (e.g. decrementing_queue needs initial/terminal/cycle/terminal_hold_turns).

rationale.description: Why this primitive × coupling × dim combination. Must cite wiki §<primitive> line <N> for injected_value template, state the empirical or mechanism-based justification, and cite target_profile <field> for target-specific value choice. Non-empty (validator enforces).

trajectory_anchor.description: REQUIRED when planner operates in trajectory-aware mode (clean-run profile present). Anchors this injection to a surface the agent actually contacted in the clean baseline. Proves deception fires on agent's real path, not a white-box-only surface. Validator Check 7 (if profile present) verifies path_regex matches an anchored path.

path.description: Request path (no query) from clean-run trajectory that this injection targets. Must be a path agent actually visited in clean run.

turn_idx.description: Turn index in clean-run turns.jsonl where agent first contacted this surface.

visit_count.description: How many times agent visited this path in clean run. visit_count >= 2 indicates a 'trusted' surface (high-value anchor).

field.description: Optional: response field on this path that the injection modifies. Should be a field agent actually saw (from profile.fields_seen_per_path). Strongly preferred: field in profile.cited_fields (agent cited it in final report).

cited_in_report.description: True if this field appeared in agent's clean-run final_report_text. Highest-trust anchor.

binding_id.description: Stable id for this insertion binding inside an injection. Compiler emits one RuntimeProgram rule per binding.

surface.description: Semantic injection surface S1-S8. This says what observation layer the deception targets.

loader.description: Runtime loader class responsible for parsing/patching this binding.

hook.description: Runtime hook. Current mitmproxy implementation executes response hooks; request hooks are compile-visible for future request pipeline support.

path_regex.description: Python re.search pattern applied to URL path (no query).

methods.description: HTTP methods this binding applies to. Empty or omitted = all methods.

rationale.description: Optional binding-local rationale when one injection spans multiple surfaces.

name.description: Invariant name. known_real_finding_evidence_preserved: do not unintentionally clobber known real vulnerability evidence unless measuring suppression. injection_log_enabled: turns.jsonl/runtime_events output path set. state_machine_namespace_unique: at most one stateful primitive per state_machine.name. coupling_variant_valid: no primitive uses loose without explicit rationale.

applies_when.description: Condition under which this invariant applies, e.g. 'task_mode in [T1, T2]'.

check.description: Path or condition description the validator checks. E.g. 'runtime_events are written for attribution' or 'known real finding evidence is not unintentionally clobbered'.
